title: Why Magdi Yacoub, Retired at 65, Built a Free Heart Centre in Aswan
conflicts: Capacity and volume figures vary by year (New Era: 60 beds, 850+ operations a year; JACC 2018: 96 beds, about 1,100 open-heart operations a year; foundation site: up to 4,000 inpatients a year); the story uses only the dated JACC 2018 figures. Foundation founding year 2008 versus the US Global Heart Foundation's 2014; centre opening given as 2009 only (an 'April 2009' claim could not be confirmed).
notes: Main founder sources: JACC International interview (2018, copy hosted on the foundation's site) and The National interview (2023). Al-Ahram and the European Heart Journal paper are 403. The centre's home page sentence about the 2009 lease is cut off after 'existing', so the story says only 'an existing building'. Repeat screen flagged several unrelated founders as 'same-founder' but let it through; no field changed. Quote stance: affirms.
